purpose: Selectable menuitem inside a dropdown-menu that handles activation, keyboard support, and optional close-on-select behavior.
useWhen: Rendering an individual action or link row inside a dropdown-menu.
Composing menu rows that should close the parent dropdown after selection unless closeOnSelect is disabled.

avoidWhen.reason: Used outside a dropdown context — it requires the dropdown provider and will throw otherwise.
Grouping a static heading row above menu items — use dropdown-label.
